description: This Java source file defines the class 'FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment' which provides a dialog interface for fingerprint-based authentication with fallback to password authentication if fingerprint is unavailable or fails. It manages UI components, lifecycle methods, and integrates with Android's fingerprint APIs.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that handles fingerprint authentication and password fallback, managing UI state and lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes fragment state, retains instance, and sets style.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI elements, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts fingerprint listening if in fingerprint stage.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Obtains references to activity, input method manager, and shared preferences.

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Assigns the cryptographic object for fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: goToBackup
methods.description: Switches UI to password authentication view.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Checks password correctness, updates preferences, and dismisses dialog if successful.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Validates the entered password; here it assumes any non-empty password is correct.

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI components based on current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles editor action from keyboard, triggers password verification.

methods.name: onAuthenticated
methods.description: Callback for successful fingerprint authentication, notifies activity.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint error, switches to password fallback.
